parent_objective: no-training tradeoff audit for weighted source-history repeat
blocked_by: M1309 weighted repeat regressed repeat robustness despite improving one split
supersedes: direct PPO or weighted objective tuning after M1309

public_gates: M1310 must not use private holdout
M1310 must compare M1309 against M1302
M1310 must report which offsets improved and regressed
M1310 must classify whether the weighted plan improved the M1304 top failed source-family/probe combo
M1310 must route to corpus/plan redesign, objective redesign, or branch synthesis
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune weights from the same audit and call it unbiased
do not treat one improved split as repeat robustness

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies why M1309 weighted repeat improved one split but reduced repeat robustness
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic audit only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit cannot match M1302 and M1309 rows
stop if audit finds top failed-combo improvement but global regression
stop if audit finds weight-induced fold overfit
stop if audit finds corpus/plan insufficiency requiring source expansion
fallback_plan: if weighted repeat is a local tradeoff, design a lexicographic or group-robust objective rather than increasing weights
if top failed combo improves but global metrics regress, redesign weighting around robust min-fold criteria
if corpus coverage is insufficient, pivot to fresh source-history corpus expansion
if audit shows a simple implementation bug, repair M1309 before further experiments
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1309 mixed regression requires audit before another implementation milestone

training_stage.stage_objective: classify weighted-repeat tradeoff before another source-history objective run
admission_evidence: M1309 uses split plan and group weights correctly
M1309 repeat robustness regresses from M1302
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: M1309 versus M1302 tradeoff is classified
top failed source-family/probe combo impact is reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1310 audits fixed-current source-history diagnostics and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: compare correct-history versus wrong-history directional outcomes across baseline and weighted repeat
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1302, M1304, M1306, and M1309 fixed-current artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If M1309 is a fold-specific or weight-induced tradeoff, keep PPO blocked and route to objective/corpus redesign or synthesis.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: M1309's best-offset improvement with repeat regression can be classified from existing artifacts as fold overfit, weight-induced tradeoff, top-failed-combo improvement with global regression, or corpus/plan insufficiency before another objective run.
success_criteria: audit compares M1309 and M1302 per offset
audit reports improved and regressed offsets
audit reports whether M1304 top failed source-family/probe combo improved
audit reports whether group weights correlate with gains or regressions
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit cannot compare M1309 and M1302
decision_rule: M1310 passes as audit infrastructure if it classifies the weighted-repeat tradeoff from existing artifacts without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion.
